Movement

Exploration movement is measured in turns (10 minutes) and dungeon movement in rounds. Encumbered characters move more slowly; the movement rate is derived from total carried weight. Running increases speed but makes stealth impossible and can cause fatigue.

Encumbrance (cn)Normal (ft/turn)Encounter (ft/round)Running (ft/round)
Up to 400120 ft40 ft120 ft
401-80090 ft30 ft90 ft
801-1,20060 ft20 ft60 ft
1,201-1,60030 ft10 ft30 ft
1,601-2,40015 ft5 ft15 ft
2,401+Cannot move——

Normal speed is measured in feet per turn and includes mapping, resting and peeking around corners. Encounter speed is one third of normal speed per round; running speed equals the normal speed in feet per round and can be maintained for at most 30 rounds before exhaustion. Outdoor movement is tripled (feet become yards). Groups move at the rate of the slowest member.

Water and air travel use their own tables for ships, rowing and flying speeds; weather and currents modify travel time.
